title: ever ELISE|Pleated V-Neck Short Sleeve Ruffled Lace Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This stunning all-over lace wedding guest dress features pleating throughout, allowing it to fit comfortably on different body types. A v-neck with short sleeves and floor-length silhouette makes the ultimate complement to your favorite heels and jewelry. A ruffle on the front adds an enchanting detail to this versatile dress.


Fit: Please refer to the size chart.


Closure: Concealed zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded enough for "No Bra" option, with lining.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.


Length: Floor-Length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.



Fabric: The garment comprises lace.


Occasion: Mother of the bride dress, Formal evening dress, Mother of the bride dress, Bridal dress, Mature formal dress, Premiere, Banquet.
